metadata.methods_description: Intracranial EEG recordings were collected from clinical sites using Blackrock and Medtronic systems during a spatial navigation task. Each session contained 50 trials (2 practice, 48 experimental) with a learning phase (two guided navigation trials per object location) and test phase (self-navigation recall). Open-loop electrical stimulation was delivered to single electrodes in hippocampus and entorhinal cortex during learning trials only, with stimulation parameters including amplitude, pulse frequency, pulse width, and pulse count recorded in behavioral event files. Stimulation and non-stimulation trials were alternated and counterbalanced with reflected object and starting positions.
